info.title: Cutting API
info.description: Standalone Cutting for Frappe 16. Tablet calls use approved Factory Device IDs. Desk calls use Frappe User roles. Frappe Delete permission controls hard deletes; deleting a Cutting Record also deletes its linked history snapshots. Standard Frappe Deleted Document recovery applies. Tablet/API deletes remain soft deletes subject to the site-day rule. The Cutting Summary compatibility method reads Frappe Cutting Record data. Machine ingest is not included.

schema.description: At most 500 operations. Creates are idempotent by device/local_event_id, including after later edits. Updates and deletes are limited to the owning device. Updates and deletes are allowed only when the record's occurred_at date is today in the Frappe site timezone; expired operations return a localized validation error. A validation failure rolls back the whole batch.

post.description: Requires an existing Factory Device that is Approved, active and assigned to a company. Unknown ID returns 404; pending, inactive or missing-company device returns 403.

color.description: Product Color.name. Select this value from the bootstrap catalog colors array.

occurred_at.description: UTC ISO timestamp; defaults to the server time.

customers.description: Active UNIQLO customers identified by exact customer code or name, ignoring case and surrounding whitespace.

products.description: Active Product options assigned to an active UNIQLO customer. The code and name values come from product_code and product_name.

colors.description: Active Product Color options. Each option uses Product Color.name as id, color_code as code and color_name as name.

markets.description: Active Market options. The id is Market.name; code and name come from code and name_en.

product_variants.description: Active combinations. The color property contains a Product Color.name while preserving the tablet API field name.
